data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 140.2m (2016: GBP 102.4m) is a deterioration of GBP 19.1m (2016: deterioration of GBP 2.8m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

named_events.loss_description: The most significant driver of this performance was the impact of the natural catastrophes which accounted for GBP 12.6m of the loss generated in the period. Gross incurred losses of GBP 24.1m (Property). Reinsurance materially mitigated net impact.
Part of Q3 catastrophe events that produced gross incurred losses (included in the GBP 24.1m for Property) and accelerated reinsurance earnings.
Non-Marine Liability experienced a number of new significant losses notably in relation to Californian utility business; reinsurance mitigated impact on 2017 result.
Issues regarding pension mis-selling and material development on specific case reserves impacted the Professional Lines class driving a loss of GBP 1.8m for the year before administrative expenses.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 324.16m. During 2017 the syndicate recorded net adverse prior-year reserve development, which on a gross basis (calculated from the gross claims development triangle) totals approximately GBP 36.6m (11.3% of opening reserves), representing an overall strengthening of reserves. The prior-year strengthening has been driven principally by adverse developments in Professional Lines and Energy and by late reporting on legacy years (notably 2013 & prior) and the loss on the 2015 year of account reinsured to close into 2016. Separately, 2017 natural catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma, Maria and Mexico earthquakes) produced significant gross losses (notably GBP 24.1m in Property) but were substantially mitigated by reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 19.1m (2016: deterioration of GBP 2.8m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
Strengthening of reserves on legacy lines on 2013 & Prior, following late reporting developments, led to a deterioration of GBP 9.3m.
The 2015 year of account reinsured to close into the 2016 year of account at 31 December 2017 at a loss of GBP 19.4m which will be called in June 2018.
The most significant driver of this performance was the impact of the natural catastrophes which accounted for GBP 12.6m of the loss generated in the period.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement was not explicitly stated as a single gross figure in the movement note; a net prior-year deterioration (GBP 19.1m) is quoted in the technical provisions note. To provide a gross PYD value the gross claims development triangle was used (page 36) - this yields a gross strengthening of c. GBP 36.585m. The narrative figures quoted in the report are often net of reinsurance; where only net figures were given these have been noted in raw_causal_phrases but not used for the gross PYD value. The 2015 reinsured-to-close transaction and legacy year adjustments may distort development comparisons; users should treat the triangle-derived gross PYD as calculated (confidence 0.8) rather than an explicit single gross movement stated in the report.
